The '''Chasdemonus Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It started at [[Naporar system/Legends|Naporar]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the core territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], one of the most significant governments in the area. After spinning off the hyperroute called the [[Path of the Houses]], it headed west towards [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outside the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] core territory, passed through the [[Colonial Station Cam'co system]], and curved toward galactic north.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chasdemonus Route was portrayed in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', on the map depicting the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] core territory and its immediate vicinity. The end point is not specified in the book.<ref name="Atlas" />
